title: cytisus capitatus subsp. ciliatus
intro: Cytisus capitatus subsp. ciliatus, commonly known as Rock Rose, is a plant species within the Fabaceae family, specifically belonging to the Cytisus genus. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, providing relief from various health issues. The health benefits of Rock Rose include its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and reduce inflammation. The bioactive constituents of Rock Rose include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, such as antioxidant and anti-inflammatory effects.
